brand_identity.description: MOCHI adalah maskot resmi Platform Informasi Akademik yang merepresentasikan karakter ramah, cerdas, interaktif, informatif, dan selalu siap membantu mahasiswa maupun dosen dalam mengakses informasi akademik.

primary.name: Primary Blue
primary.usage: Primary brand color, interactive elements, and dominant visual accents.

secondary.name: Sky Blue
secondary.usage: Secondary surfaces, gradients, supporting illustrations, and highlights.

accent.name: Cyan Blue
accent.usage: Mascot body accents, interactive highlights, and decorative elements.

supporting.name: Ice Blue
supporting.usage: Soft backgrounds, illustration highlights, and subtle containers.

outline.name: Deep Blue
outline.usage: Deep shadows, contrast accents, and visual depth.

primary_font.usage: Brand headings, website headings, navigation, and prominent interface text.

secondary_font.usage: Body text, descriptions, labels, and supporting information.

typography_rules: Maintain sufficient contrast between text and backgrounds.

primary_logo.description: A rounded square icon containing the MOCHI mascot face wearing a blue graduation cap.

logo_variations.name: Primary Icon
logo_variations.description: Full mascot face inside a rounded square.

logo_variations.name: Mascot Only
logo_variations.description: MOCHI character without the surrounding square background.

logo_variations.name: Brand Lockup
logo_variations.description: MOCHI icon combined with the MOCHI wordmark.

logo_guidelines.clear_space: Maintain sufficient empty space around the logo to preserve visual clarity.

body.proportion: Large rounded head and body with a compact overall silhouette

mouth.default_visibility: No prominent mouth in the original reference
mouth.expression_variations: Small, simple, rounded mouth shapes may be used for expressive illustrations.

eyebrows.default_visibility: Not present in the original reference
eyebrows.expression_variations: Optional minimal eyebrow-like shapes when required for emotional expression.

graduation_cap.style: Rounded, smooth, glossy, and softly illuminated
graduation_cap.position: Centered on top of the mascot head

consistency_rules: All views must represent the same character.
Maintain graduation cap dimensions and placement.
Keep the same material and shading style.
Maintain consistent eye placement and dimensions.

rules: Expressions must remain recognizable as MOCHI.
Only facial features and body language may change.
Do not change the original character silhouette.
Do not permanently modify the eye design.
Avoid poses that require unapproved anatomical features.

composition.spacing: Consistent spacing with sufficient breathing room
composition.visual_hierarchy: Clear distinction between primary and supporting elements

use_cases.name: Welcome
use_cases.description: MOCHI greeting users with a friendly expression.

use_cases.name: Empty State
use_cases.description: MOCHI expressing curiosity or confusion when no data is available.

use_cases.name: Loading
use_cases.description: MOCHI performing a simple waiting or working animation.

use_cases.name: Error
use_cases.description: MOCHI displaying a concerned or apologetic expression.
MOCHI looking confused or searching for missing content.

use_cases.name: Onboarding
use_cases.description: MOCHI guiding users through academic platform features.

use_cases.name: Dashboard
use_cases.description: MOCHI supporting academic information and dashboard interactions.

use_cases.name: Notification
use_cases.description: MOCHI communicating reminders and academic announcements.

use_cases.name: Feature Illustration
use_cases.description: MOCHI interacting with objects related to academic activities.

asset_guidelines.background: Transparent when used as an isolated mascot illustration
asset_guidelines.scalability: Preserve visual clarity at different display sizes

principles.name: Consistency
principles.description: All visual elements must maintain the same brand identity.

principles.name: Simplicity
principles.description: Keep illustrations and interface elements simple and easy to understand.

principles.name: Friendliness
principles.description: Use soft shapes, approachable expressions, and welcoming visual elements.

principles.name: Clarity
principles.description: Prioritize readable information and clear visual hierarchy.

principles.name: Accessibility
principles.description: Maintain sufficient contrast, readable typography, and understandable visual feedback.

principles.name: Flexibility
principles.description: Allow MOCHI to appear in different poses and contexts without changing its identity.

principles.name: Recognizability
principles.description: Preserve distinctive visual characteristics so MOCHI remains identifiable across the platform.

do: Use the approved MOCHI reference image.
Maintain the blue and cyan color palette.
Keep the graduation cap as a defining accessory.
Maintain consistent proportions and facial structure.
Use expressions appropriate to the interface context.
Use soft lighting and glossy shading.
Keep illustrations visually clean and approachable.
dont: Do not redesign the original character.
Do not change the primary body shape.
Do not replace the graduation cap.
Do not arbitrarily change the mascot color palette.
Do not add unnecessary anatomical features.
Do not use inconsistent illustration styles.
Do not distort the character proportions.
Do not create a different mascot interpretation.

ai_generation_guidelines.purpose: Generate consistent MOCHI illustrations for the Academic Information Platform.
prompt_requirements: Use the exact MOCHI mascot identity from the supplied reference image.
Maintain the original rounded blue and white blob-like body.
Preserve the two white oval eyes.
Preserve the blue graduation cap and white tassel.
Use glossy 3D-inspired rendering with soft blue gradients.
Maintain consistent lighting, material, and proportions.
Change only the requested expression, pose, or activity.
Avoid introducing unrelated character features or accessories.
